marks.gloss_en: (entertained inference) our mishna implies: if the writer says 'give it', the found document is delivered -- even long after it was lost
Gittin 27a: an agent who lost a gett may use a found one only if found immediately
Rabba: the immediate-only rule holds where passing caravans are common; the return rule where they are not
refinement: even where caravans are common, the concern requires that two couples of identical names be established in one town
Rav Huna, on the gett found in his court naming Sheviri-on-the-Rakhis: we suspect a second town named Sheviri
